xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5005: Command Deck tree shows no report or verdict for remote gauntlet lanes

plan.title: Command Deck tree shows no report or verdict for remote gauntlet lanes ("8 lanes · 4 reported" when all 8 reported)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The conversation list computes lane report, iteration and verdict fields (laneEnrichment in src/lib/overdeck/conversation-list.ts) from home's conversations table only, and before linked rows are merged. So remote lane rows in GET /api/conversations carry no laneReport/laneVerdict, a home builder judged by a remote critic gets no laneLatestVerdict, and the Command Deck group summary undercounts reported lanes ("8 lanes · 4 reported"). pan lane list is correct because views.ts pairs over listAllLaneRows.
narratives.Proposal: Extract laneEnrichment into a new leaf module src/lib/lanes/lane-list-fields.ts (laneFieldsByRun) that pairs over listAllLaneRows (local rows plus stand-ins, mirrored reports, lane-link.json sidecars). conversation-list.ts uses it for local rows; getMergedConversationList uses it for the runs of unarchived stand-ins and passes the fields to mergeConversationRows through a new optional RemoteLaneEntry.fields, which the merge spreads onto the stamped linked row. laneLatestVerdict gains a server-computed criticRoute (String(id) or @<environmentId>/<name>) and criticId becomes number|null; the builder row's verdict link uses criticRoute. Docs in reference/lanes.mdx, docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md and the codebase map describe the new behavior. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5005.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not change groupSummary, badge colors, or the badge vocabulary.
- Do not stamp lane fields on linked rows of archived stand-ins.
- Do not add a cache for laneFieldsByRun.
- Do not change pan lane list, GET /api/lanes, src/lib/lanes/views.ts, or the remote-lane follower.
- Do not show remote lane activity, git facts or cost in the tree.
- Do not address the Auto-placement reason gap (#5006).
- Do not import views.ts or conversation-list.ts from the new module.

autoDecisions.summary: One shared laneFieldsByRun function in a new module src/lib/lanes/lane-list-fields.ts serves both the local enriched list and the merged list.
autoDecisions.rationale: One computation keeps the tree and pan lane list in agreement, mirrors views.ts, shrinks conversation-list.ts, and avoids an import cycle with views.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Remote lane fields travel to the pure merge through an optional RemoteLaneEntry.fields.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the existing PAN-4638 stamping seam and keeps mergeConversationRows pure and unit-testable.

autoDecisions.summary: laneLatestVerdict gains a server-computed criticRoute (String(id) locally, linkedConversationName(environmentId, name) remotely); criticId becomes number|null.
autoDecisions.rationale: A remote critic has no local id, so /conv/${criticId} would become /conv/null; the server already has the environment id, and the frontend router already opens /conv/@<env>/<name>.

autoDecisions.summary: Pairing activity for a remote row is mirror.activity, or 'stopped' when archived or unmirrored; a local row keeps conversation status.
autoDecisions.rationale: Activity only feeds CriticSummary.activity, which no emitted field uses; importing remoteActivity from views.ts would create an import cycle.

autoDecisions.summary: Accept recomputing pairing in the merged path for runs that also have home lanes; no new cache.
autoDecisions.rationale: Bounded by the lanes of runs with remote lanes; reports are small file reads; NFR-1 skips the work entirely when there are no unarchived stand-ins.

autoDecisions.summary: No live three-machine check is required for merge; unit tests cover each FR.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reproducing needs linked machines that CI and the work agent do not have; the fix is a data-shape change fully observable in unit tests.

items.title: Pair conversation-list lane fields over local and remote lanes in a new laneFieldsByRun module

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5005.md WI-1 exactly. Create src/lib/lanes/lane-list-fields.ts exporting interface LaneListFields and async laneFieldsByRun(runs: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, LaneListFields>> (code given in the PRD). It builds context from listAllLaneRows({ run }) per unique run, computes laneIterations(context), reads latestWorkerReport(`conv-${name}`) per lane with concurrency 8, builds PairingRows (activity: 'stopped' if archived, else local.status, else remote.mirror?.activity ?? 'stopped'), and returns for every lane: laneReport {seq,at,status,verdict}, laneIteration, laneVerdict for critic/verifier, laneLatestVerdict for builders as {value, defects, criticId: number|null, criticRoute} where criticRoute is String(id) for a local critic and linkedConversationName(remote.facts.environmentId, name) for a remote critic. It must not import views.ts or conversation-list.ts. In conversation-list.ts delete laneEnrichment, call laneFieldsByRun with the page's lane runs, spread fields only when row.laneKey is set (`...(row.laneKey ? lanes.get(row.name) ?? {} : {})`), and remove the imports this orphans. Delete localIterationRow from iteration.ts (its only caller is gone) and narrow its import to LaneRole. Add lane-list-fields.test.ts (temp OVERDECK_HOME, real DB and stand-in store, pattern from views-remote.test.ts) and update conversation-list-lane-pairing.test.ts to mock ../../lanes/remote-lanes.js and expect criticRoute '2'.

Stamp lane list fields onto remote lane rows in the merged conversation list

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2. Add optional `fields?: LaneListFields` (type import from ../lanes/lane-list-fields.js) to RemoteLaneEntry in src/lib/overdeck/linked-conversations-merge.ts and spread `...(lane.fields ?? {})` after the lane facts in the stamped row; add one sentence to the module header's FR-8 bullet. In getMergedConversationList (src/dashboard/server/services/conversation-list-merged.ts) collect unarchived stand-ins first, then if any exist call laneFieldsByRun(unique runs).catch(() => new Map()) once and set each entry's fields from the map by facts.name; when there are no unarchived stand-ins do not call it. Add merge tests (fields spread; no fields => no laneReport key) and merged-list tests mocking remote-lanes.js and lane-list-fields.js (fields reach @env-desk/conv-x; one call with ['r1']; no stand-ins => no call).
